Merely making exponentiated outputs sum to one is insufficient: unequal inputs must retain their distinct probabilities. Preserve ordinary CUDA softmax values, nearby aligned widths, float32 behavior and the first-order input gradients of softmax/log_softmax. This candidate exercises finite two-dimensional float32/float64 tensors with 1 to 5 rows, widths from 1 to 1024 and input values in [-608,608], including noncontiguous tensors, either axis and equivalent negative dimensions.
